subject: Islamic Religious Studies
examFormat: Papers 1 and 2 are taken at one sitting as a composite paper. Paper 1 comprises fifty multiple-choice questions, all answered in 50 minutes for 50 marks. Paper 2 has six essay questions, one of them compulsory; candidates answer the compulsory question and any three optional ones in 2 hours for 100 marks. The syllabus has four parts: Tarikh, Qur'an, Hadith, and Tawhid and Fiqh.

topics.name: The Jahiliyyah: Arabia before Islam
objectives: Describe the location of Arabia
Describe social life - marriage, divorce and inheritance
Describe religious life - idol worship and names of major gods/idols
Describe political life - system of government
Describe economic life - sources of livelihood
Describe the reforms introduced by Islam on the Jahiliyyah practices

subtopics.name: Birth and marriage of the Prophet
objectives: Discuss his birth
Discuss his marriage

subtopics.name: Call to prophethood and his mission
Hijrah
objectives: Explain the causes, course and significance of the Hijrah

subtopics.name: Formation of the Ummah and the Madinan Constitution
The Battles of Badr, Uhud and Khandaq
objectives: Explain the causes, courses and effects of the battles of Badr, Uhud and Khandaq

subtopics.name: The Treaty of Hudaybiyyah
objectives: State the terms and outcomes of the Treaty of Hudaybiyyah

subtopics.name: The Farewell Pilgrimage
objectives: Describe the Farewell Pilgrimage, the sermon and its lessons

topics.name: The Khulafa'ur-Rashidun (The Rightly-guided Caliphs)
objectives: Describe the biographies of Abu-Bakr Ibn Abi Quhhafah, Umar Ibn al-Khattab, Uthman Ibn Affan and Ali Ibn Abi Talib
Discuss the contributions of each of the four Caliphs to Islam
State the lessons learnt from their lives

subtopics.name: Spread of Islam in West Africa
objectives: Discuss the advent and roles of traders, teachers, murabitun, sufi orders, mujaddidun (reformers) and Hajj in the spread of Islam

subtopics.name: Impact of Islam on ancient West African empires
objectives: Assess the impact of Islam on the socio-political, economic and linguistic lives of the peoples of the ancient West African empires (Ghana, Mali, Songhai and Kanem-Borno)

topics.name: Revelation and Preservation of the Qur'an

subtopics.name: Revelation of the Qur'an
objectives: Describe the visits of the Prophet (S.A.W.) to Cave Hira, the first revelation and his reaction to it
Describe the different modes of revelation
Explain the piecemeal revelation of the Qur'an

subtopics.name: Preservation of the Qur'an
objectives: Explain the complete arrangement of the Qur'an, including the distinction between Makki and Madani Suwar
Explain the recording, compilation and standardization of the Qur'an
State the roles played by the Companions of the Prophet (S.A.W.) in its preservation

subtopics.name: Importance of the Qur'an
objectives: Explain the Qur'an as a source of guidance in social, political, spiritual and moral matters

topics.name: Selected Suwar of the Qur'an
objectives: Read (in Arabic text or transliteration), memorize and explain the meaning of the prescribed suwar and apply the lessons learnt from them (identification, explanation, interpretation and application)
topics.content: Prescribed suwar: Suratul-Fatihah (Q.1); Suratud-Duha (Q.93); Suratut-Tin (Q.95); Suratul-Alaq (Q.96:1-5); Suratul-Qadr (Q.97); Suratul-Kafirun (Q.109); Suratun-Nasr (Q.110); Suratul-Ikhlas (Q.112); Suratul-Falaq (Q.113); Suratun-Nas (Q.114).

subtopics.name: Attitudes to Parents
objectives: Discuss attitudes to parents (Q.17:23-24; 31:13-15)

subtopics.name: Honesty in Words and Deeds
objectives: Discuss honesty in words and deeds (Q.2:42; 61:2-3; 17:35)

subtopics.name: Prohibition of Gambling
objectives: Explain the prohibition of gambling (Q.2:219; 5:90-91)

topics.name: Hadith and Sunnah
objectives: Explain the definition of Hadith and Sunnah
Explain the differences and similarities between Hadith and Sunnah
Explain the importance of Hadith and Sunnah
Explain the parts of the Hadith: Isnad, Matn and Rawi
Explain the criteria for authenticity of Hadith
Explain the classification of Hadith: Sahih, Hasan and Da'if
Explain the Six Sound Collections of Hadith (Sihaus-Sittah) and their compilers

topics.name: Selected Ahadith
objectives: Read (in Arabic text or transliteration), memorize and explain the meaning of the prescribed Ahadith and apply the lessons learnt from them (identification, explanation, interpretation and application)

subtopics.name: Meaning and Significance of Iman
objectives: Explain the meaning and significance of Iman (Faith)

subtopics.name: Belief in Allah
objectives: Explain belief in Allah with emphasis on Kalimatush-Shahadah (Q.2:163, 255; 3:18; 17:42-43; 21:22; 23:91; 112)
Discuss Islam and the concept of Trinity (Q.4:171; 5:75-76; 19:92-93; 112)

subtopics.name: Belief in His angels
objectives: Explain belief in the angels (Q.2:285; 8:50; 16:2; 66:6; 82:10-12)

subtopics.name: Belief in His books
objectives: Explain belief in the divine books (Q.2:2, 285; 87:19; 5:46)

subtopics.name: Belief in His Prophets
objectives: Explain belief in the Prophets with special emphasis on the Ulul-Azm: Ibrahim, Nuh, Musa, Isa and Muhammad (Q.6:83-87; 4:164; 10:47; 21:107; 46:35) and relevant ahadith

subtopics.name: The Day of Resurrection, Judgement and Eternal Life
objectives: Explain belief in the Day of Resurrection, Judgement and Eternal Life (Q.20:15; 32:10-20; 36:78-70; 75:3-13)

subtopics.name: Destiny (Qada and Qadar)
objectives: Explain Qada and Qadar and distinguish between the two concepts (Q.3:145; 25:2; 76:3; 87:3)

subtopics.name: Worship of idols
objectives: Explain the worship of idols (Q.4:48; 22:31; 31:13; 41:37)

subtopics.name: Ancestor and Hero-worship
objectives: Explain ancestor and hero-worship (Q.3:64; 4:116; 112:4; 2:13, 40-41)

topics.name: Salat
objectives: Explain the meaning of Salat
Explain the importance of Salat
Explain acts that vitiate Salat
Explain joining a congregational Salat
Explain Sujudus-Sahwi (Prostration of Forgetfulness)

subtopics.name: Obligatory Salat
objectives: Explain how the obligatory Salat (Subh/Fajr, Zuhr, Asr, Maghrib and Isha'i) is observed

subtopics.name: Non-Obligatory Salat
objectives: Explain how the Nawafil that accompany the obligatory salawat, Duha, Witr, etc. are observed

subtopics.name: Special prayers
objectives: Explain how Jum'ah, Idayn, Janazah, Istisqa', Tarawih, Kusufayn and Istikhara are observed

topics.name: Sawm (Fasting)
objectives: Study Sawm with emphasis on its spiritual, social and moral objectives

subtopics.name: Types of Sawm
objectives: Define Sawm
Distinguish compulsory and voluntary Sawm

subtopics.name: Compulsory fasts
objectives: Explain the compulsory fasts: Ramadan, Kaffarah and Nadr

subtopics.name: Voluntary fasts
objectives: Explain the voluntary fasts: Shitta Shawwal, Ashura' and Tasu'a, fasting on Mondays and Thursdays, etc.

subtopics.name: Observance of the Ramadan fast
objectives: Explain how fasting is observed in Islam and the Ramadan fast
State those exempted from fast
State the things that vitiate fast

subtopics.name: Benefits of Sawm
objectives: State the spiritual, social and moral benefits and significance of Sawm

topics.name: Zakat (Charity)
objectives: Study Zakat with emphasis on its spiritual, socio-economic and moral objectives

subtopics.name: Zakat and Sadaqah
objectives: Define Zakat and Sadaqah
State the difference between Zakat and Sadaqah

subtopics.name: Articles on which Zakat is paid
objectives: Identify the articles on which Zakat is paid
State the Nisab of Zakat
Explain Zakat on livestock, money and agricultural products

subtopics.name: Beneficiaries of Zakat
objectives: Identify the beneficiaries of Zakat (Q.9:60)

subtopics.name: Benefits of Zakat
objectives: State the spiritual, socio-economic and moral benefits of Zakat

topics.name: Hajj (Pilgrimage)
objectives: Study Hajj and Umrah with emphasis on their spiritual, socio-economic and moral values

subtopics.name: Definition and Origin of Hajj and 'Umrah
Pre-requisites to the performance of Hajj
Acts that affect the validity of Hajj
Types of Hajj
objectives: Identify the types of Hajj: Ifrad, Tamattu' and Qiran

subtopics.name: Significance of Hajj
objectives: State the spiritual, socio-economic and moral objectives of Hajj

topics.name: Shari'ah
objectives: Explain the definition of Shari'ah
Explain the sources of Shari'ah (the Qur'an, the Sunnah, the Ijma' and the Qiyas)
Explain the significance of Shari'ah

subtopics.name: Concept of Nikah
objectives: Explain the concept of Nikah (Q.16:72; 24:32; 30:21; the Hadith "O young man...")

subtopics.name: Prohibited categories in marriage
objectives: Identify the prohibited categories (Q.2:221; 4:22-24)

subtopics.name: Conditions governing validity of Nikah
objectives: State the conditions governing validity (Q.4:4, 21, 24-25; al-Bukhari 67:29, 37, 42, 49, 51-52; Abu-Da'ud 12:29-31)

subtopics.name: Rights and duties of husband and wife
objectives: State the rights and duties of husband and wife (Q.2:228-230; 20:132; 33:33; 41:34; 65:6)

subtopics.name: Prohibition of ill-treatment of wife (Idrar)
objectives: Explain the law prohibiting the ill-treatment of wife (Idrar) (Q.65:6)

subtopics.name: Islam's attitude to divorce
objectives: Explain Islam's attitude to divorce (Q.4:35; the Hadith "of all things lawful... most hateful to Allah", Abu-Da'ud 13:31)

subtopics.name: Kinds of divorce
objectives: Distinguish Talaq, Khul', Faskh, Mubara'ah, Zihar and Li'an (Q.2:228-230; Q.65)

subtopics.name: 'Iddatut-Talaq
objectives: Explain the meaning, duration and implication of the waiting period for a divorced woman
